plates.reference: Own code graphic: on period paper, an inked chemical-formula vs 3D-structure comparison diagram contrasts William Perkin's 1856 additive formula calculation (2 C10H13N + 3 O → C20H24N2O2 + H2O, which oxidized aniline into purple Mauveine C26H23N4+/C27H25N4+ instead of quinine, synthesized only in 1944) against Pelletier and Caventou's 1820 natural quinine alkaloid extracted at ~2–8% yield from Andean cinchona bark.
